# Cloning

Wolfgate's fixes on top of the genetic database cloning in `_Mono/Cloning`. A body scanner console stores a genetic
record; a clone made from that record later keeps the character's speech voice, emote voices, message sound and
genital template, even if the body is gone by then. Stations and ships with a cloning pod have a genetic database and
a linked body scanner console mapped in.

Entry points: `WFCloneTemplateSystem` (capture at scan, apply at clone) and `WFCloneTemplate` (the stored data), used
by `GeneticCloningSystem`.
